column4: Verify student is able to login with valid credentials
column6:

column4: Verify completing L3 (Letter Train) and P3 (Letter Hunt) navigates to A1 (Apply 1 challenge)

column7: Completing L3 then P3 advances to A1 (Apply 1): the app shows a 'Hurray!!! Ready for Challenge?' screen with a Start Game button. Implementation reuses completeLetterTrain + completeLetterHuntPractice (no new mechanics); verified in the single-session E2E (17/17 passing, headed).

column4: Verify the student completes A1 (Apply challenge) then the L4/P4 - L5/P5 - L6/P6 lessons through to the A2 entry
column5: Student should be on the A1 'Ready for Challenge?' entry after TC-017
column6:
1. Click 'Start Game' to begin A1 (the Apply challenge); complete all 3 levels (10 questions each), tapping the matching letter per question (answer read via the play() hook), using 'Next Level' between levels and 'Continue' at the end -> L4
2. Complete three Learn->Practice pairs, validating each transition: L4 Letter Train -> P4 Letter Hunt -> L5 Letter Train -> P5 Letter Hunt -> L6 Letter Train -> P6 Letter Hunt
3. Letter Trains use learn arrows + the say-the-word mic with SAPI-TTS injection; Letter Hunts use the play() hook + tap
4. Verify the A2 'Ready for Challenge?' (Apply 2) entry screen is shown
5. Validate each stage advances (A1 -> L4 -> P4 -> L5 -> P5 -> L6 -> P6 -> A2)
column7: Clicking Start Game begins A1; completing its 3 levels advances to L4. The three Learn/Practice pairs (L4/P4, L5/P5, L6/P6) each transition correctly and P6 leads to the A2 'Ready for Challenge?' entry. Reuses completeApplyChallenge + completeLearnPracticePair (completeLetterTrain + completeLetterHuntPractice). NOTE: Letter Trains have VARIABLE lengths (L1-L5 = /16, L6 = /14); train detection was made length-independent (text counter with denominator >= 11, excludes the practice/Apply '/10'). Verified in the single-session E2E (19/19 passing, headed, ~24 min).

column7: Completing A2 advances to L7; the three Learn/Practice pairs (L7/P7, L8/P8, L9/P9) each transition correctly to the A3 'Ready for Challenge?' entry; completing A3 advances the student past the challenge. New helper completeWordRecognitionPractice solves it; completeApplyChallenge gained an additive word-answer fallback (F1's single-letter path is checked first, so F1 is unchanged). Reached F2 via login->English (Testf2auto). PASSED headed (~7 min): nodes StartF L(18) P L(18) P L(18) P A1, level F2. Runs as its own single-session suite (foundation-f2.spec.ts) to avoid replaying Discovery+F1.

2. Complete P1-P5 'Letter Launcher': each round a letter is shown and a letter is spoken (recovered in-page); press the tick if they match, the cross if not (each correct fills the rocket fuel; reach the fuel target before the timer)
3. Complete the A1 Apply (3 Letter-Launcher levels, fuel /100)
4. Validate progression P1 -> P5 -> A1
column7: F3 is a chain of mini-games (NOT the F1/F2 Letter Train + Hunt). P1-P5 are 'Letter Launcher' (shown vs spoken letter -> tick/cross). Solved by new helper completeLetterLauncher (audio recovered via installLetterLauncherHook: preloaded /letter/<X>.wav mapped to the played blob by byte size). A1 = 3 launcher levels. Additive to FoundationPage; F1/F2 untouched. Verified via the completeF3 drive (P1->A3 to Foundation completion).
